customer_type: Households, tea stalls, sweet shops within walking/cycling distance
supplier_dependency: High - dependent on cattle feed suppliers and, if processing, on chilling/collection infrastructure
seasonality: Moderate - milk yield dips in summer/dry season and rises post-monsoon with fodder availability
main_operational_risks: Perishability of product, cold-chain gaps, disease outbreaks in livestock, price fluctuation set by cooperatives
key_demand_indicators: Number of milch cattle in area, presence of existing milk collection points, distance to nearest chilling centre

customer_type: Individual customers, local schools (uniforms), small boutiques for job-work
supplier_dependency: Low-Moderate - depends on fabric/thread wholesalers, often sourced from nearby town markets
seasonality: High - festival and wedding seasons (e.g. Diwali, wedding season) drive sharp demand spikes
main_operational_risks: Skill-dependent quality variance, seasonal idle periods, competition from ready-made garments
key_demand_indicators: Number of existing tailoring shops nearby, presence of schools/colleges requiring uniforms, upcoming wedding season

supplier_dependency: Moderate - dependent on wholesale distributors/distributors' delivery reliability
seasonality: Low - fairly stable year-round demand with minor festival-driven spikes
main_operational_risks: Thin margins, competition from larger supermarkets/chains in semi-urban areas, credit-based sales risk
key_demand_indicators: Household density within walking distance, presence of competing general stores, road/market accessibility
